home.prep_text: Cold nights are coming. Three things worth doing before you run the heat all season.

prep.title: Furnace Safety Inspection & Tune-Up
prep.text: We check burners, heat exchanger, venting and carbon monoxide safety, then tune it so it lights clean and runs efficiently all winter.

prep.title: Dryer Vent Cleaning
prep.text: Holiday laundry and heavy blankets mean longer dryer runs. A clear vent dries faster and cuts lint fire risk.
